entries.title: Judges 14:1
segments: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

entries.title: Judges 14:2
segments: And he came up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines. And now get her for me for a wife.

entries.title: Judges 14:3
segments: And his father and his mother said to him, [Is there] no woman among the daughters of your brothers, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said to his father, Get her for me, for she pleases me very much.

entries.title: Judges 14:4
segments: But his father and his mother did not know that it [was] from the LORD, that He [was] looking for an occasion against the Philistines. For at that time the Philistines had the rule over Israel.

entries.title: Judges 14:5
segments: And Samson and his father and his mother went down to Timnath. And they came to the vineyards of Timnath. And, behold, a young lion roared to meet him.

entries.title: Judges 14:6
segments: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he tore it as he would have torn a kid; and nothing was in his hand. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

entries.title: Judges 14:7
segments: And he went down and talked with the woman. And she pleased Samson very much.

entries.title: Judges 14:8
segments: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the dead body of the lion. And behold! A swarm of bees and honey [was] in the dead body of the lion.

entries.title: Judges 14:9
segments: And he took some of it in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother. And he gave to them, and they ate. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the dead body of the lion.

entries.title: Judges 14:10
segments: And his father went down to the woman. And Samson made a feast there, for so the young men used to do.

entries.title: Judges 14:11
segments: And it happened when they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

entries.title: Judges 14:12
segments: And Samson said to them, I will now put forth a riddle to you. If you certainly tell it to me [within] the seven days of the feast, and find [it] out, then I will give you thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments.

entries.title: Judges 14:13
segments: But if you cannot tell me, then you shall give me thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments. And they said to him, Put forth your riddle so that we may hear it.

entries.title: Judges 14:14
segments: And he said to them, Out of the eater came forth food, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And in three days they could not tell what the riddle.

entries.title: Judges 14:15
segments: And it happened on the seventh day they said to Samson's wife, Lure your husband so that he may tell the riddle to us, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire. Have you called us to take what we have? [Is it] not [so]?

entries.title: Judges 14:16
segments: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, You only hate me, and do not love [me]. You have put forth a riddle to the sons of my people, and have not told [it] to me. And he said to her, Behold, I have not told my father nor to my mother, and shall I tell you?

entries.title: Judges 14:17
segments: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted. And on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed hard upon him. And she told the riddle to the sons of her people.

entries.title: Judges 14:18
segments: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What [is] sweeter than honey, and what stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found [out]  my riddle.

entries.title: Judges 14:19
segments: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave changes of garments to them who told what the riddle meant. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

entries.title: Judges 14:20
segments: But Samson's wife was [given] to his companion, who had served as his friend.
